scope: General recent digest selection only. STU foundational专题 excluded from this union. 39 original plus 5 addendum candidates.
reviewerRole: Fresh independent selection jury; did not retrieve shards or author production reports. Same model family, so provisional independent review rather than cross-family validation.
selectionCountRationale: 选9篇而非默认5–8：新增第9篇保留物理雷达渲染链路，与雷达运动实体不重复；网络韧性、协商、伪仿真、VLA基础、世界动作计算、人类因果表示和工具测试均有实质证据。没有按方向配额降低门槛；LiDAR未知物专题另审，室内/操作机器人不作道路覆盖。

rubric.rule: 质量门槛必要非充分；考虑机制互补、资源可核验和篇幅。没有可用代码不会自动淘汰，但降低public asset readiness。数据集/协议论文的method novelty衡量表示和评价设计，experimental closure衡量标注/验证闭合而非强求新模型。

checkedSections: whole-text searches for resampling, repeated batches, seeds and rounds
findings: No statement was found that the scenario batch changes across the three tuning rounds. Such a change could explain some dispersion but would contradict or require qualification of the stated LLM-only stochasticity; it must not be invented as an explanation.
If the scenario set and configuration are fixed and the planner deterministic, repeated after scores and paired deltas must have zero SD; Table2 reports nonzero values.

If the baseline score is fixed across rounds, SD(after-baseline) equals SD(after). N50 reports9.1 vs6.8; N400 reports0.4 vs0.3. These different displayed SDs require a variable baseline, additional aggregation or another unreported procedure.

For one fixed unweighted N400 binary success batch,50.4% is not a possible success rate rounded to one decimal (counts increment0.25pp). It could arise from averaging different batches or weights, but that is not specified.

AppendixA.6 studies200 YAML requests and191 in-vocabulary configurations; AppendixA.7 uses one shared100-scenario batch for qualitative cross-planner dispatch. Neither supplies the missing Table2 repeated-run protocol.
